cards.example_en: Too much direct sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
cards.example_zh: 过多的阳光直射会伤害你的皮肤。
cards.explain_zh: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。

cards.example_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harmful effects of water pollution on local ecosystems.
cards.example_zh: 加强对工业废物的管控，可以减少水污染对当地生态系统的有害影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her willingness to help made the move much easier.
cards.example_zh: 她乐意帮忙，让这次搬家轻松了许多。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词，常接to do表示做某事的意愿。

cards.example_en: The technician replaced a broken part in our washing machine.
cards.example_zh: 技师更换了我们洗衣机里一个损坏的零件。
cards.explain_zh: technician 侧重设备操作维护，不等同于 engineer。

cards.example_en: I usually pour soy milk over my breakfast cereal.
cards.example_zh: 我通常把豆奶倒在早餐麦片上。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语也常用soya；“酱油”通常说soy sauce。

cards.example_en: I usually pour soy milk over my breakfast cereal.
cards.example_zh: 我通常把豆奶倒在早餐麦片上。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A puncture in my bicycle tyre made me late.
cards.example_zh: 我的自行车轮胎被扎破了，害得我迟到了。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语说get a puncture；美式常说get a flat。

cards.example_en: The unconscious patient was breathing steadily beneath a blanket.
cards.example_zh: 失去知觉的病人盖着毯子，呼吸平稳。
cards.explain_zh: unconscious of表示未察觉；昏迷不是普通睡眠。

cards.example_en: Unconscious bias can influence recruitment decisions, even when employers aim to treat all applicants fairly.
cards.example_zh: 即使雇主力求公平对待所有求职者，无意识的偏见仍可能影响招聘决定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I used a shovel to clear the snowy path.
cards.example_zh: 我用铲子清除了小路上的积雪。
cards.explain_zh: 英式过去式为shovelled，美式为shoveled。

cards.example_en: I was ignorant of the rules until someone explained them.
cards.example_zh: 直到有人解释，我才了解这些规则。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be ignorant of；直接形容人可能带贬义。

cards.example_en: Consumers who remain ignorant of online privacy risks may share sensitive information without considering the consequences.
cards.example_zh: 不了解网络隐私风险的消费者，可能会在未考虑后果的情况下分享敏感信息。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: An acquaintance from my yoga class waved at me.
cards.example_zh: 瑜伽课上认识的一位熟人向我挥了挥手。
cards.explain_zh: 指熟人时可数；表示了解时常接with。

cards.example_en: Even a basic acquaintance with local customs can help international students adapt more easily to life abroad.
cards.example_zh: 即使只是对当地习俗略有了解，也能帮助国际学生更轻松地适应海外生活。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She sighed in frustration when the printer jammed again.
cards.example_zh: 打印机又卡纸了，她懊恼地叹了口气。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到frustrated；令人受挫的事物是frustrating。

cards.example_en: She sighed in frustration when the printer jammed again.
cards.example_zh: 打印机又卡纸了，她懊恼地叹了口气。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My grandmother often quotes a proverb about being patient.
cards.example_zh: 我祖母经常引用一句劝人耐心的谚语。
cards.explain_zh: proverb是流传的完整俗谚；idiom多为固定习语。

cards.example_en: A traditional proverb can reveal the values that a community passes down through successive generations.
cards.example_zh: 传统谚语可以揭示一个群体代代相传的价值观。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We watched a white yacht sail across the bay.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一艘白色帆船驶过海湾。
cards.explain_zh: ch不发音；通常指休闲或竞赛用船。

cards.example_en: He carried a lantern along the dark garden path.
cards.example_zh: 他提着一盏灯，沿着漆黑的花园小径走去。
cards.explain_zh: 指有外罩的灯，常可提携；不等同于手电筒。

cards.example_en: A small pimple appeared on my chin overnight.
cards.example_zh: 一夜之间，我的下巴上冒出了一颗小痘痘。
cards.explain_zh: pimple指单颗痘痘；acne指痤疮这种皮肤问题。

cards.example_en: Without regular feeding, these rescued animals could starve.
cards.example_zh: 如果不定期喂食，这些获救的动物可能会饿死。
cards.explain_zh: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

cards.example_en: I envy your ability to sleep on noisy trains.
cards.example_zh: 我真羡慕你能在嘈杂的火车上睡着。
cards.explain_zh: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。

cards.example_en: The bakery uses a wheat stalk as its logo.
cards.example_zh: 这家面包店用一支麦穗作为徽标。
cards.explain_zh: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

cards.example_en: A distinctive logo helps consumers recognise a company, but product quality is essential for building lasting trust.
cards.example_zh: 独特的徽标帮助消费者识别企业，但产品质量才是建立持久信任的关键。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The roses bloom beside our kitchen window every summer.
cards.example_zh: 每年夏天，玫瑰都在我们的厨房窗边盛开。
cards.explain_zh: bloom可作动词；表示正在开花用in bloom。

cards.meaning_zh: 座位间过道；货架间通道
cards.example_en: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
cards.example_zh: 请不要把包放在过道上。
cards.explain_zh: s不发音，与isle同音；aisle seat是靠过道座位。

cards.example_en: My little brother is possessive about his toy trains.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟对他的玩具火车占有欲很强。
cards.explain_zh: 对物占有欲强常用about；语法中指所属关系。

cards.example_en: My little brother is possessive about his toy trains.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟对他的玩具火车占有欲很强。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I feel more motivated after exercising in the morning.
cards.example_zh: 早晨运动之后，我感觉更有干劲。
cards.explain_zh: motivated to do表示有动力做；by引出动机。

cards.example_en: A strange odour came from the kitchen bin.
cards.example_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里飘出一股怪味。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写odour，美式odor；常指难闻气味。

cards.example_en: Leave the butter outside the fridge to soften.
cards.example_zh: 把黄油放在冰箱外，让它变软。
cards.explain_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：热使黄油变软，黄油也会自行变软。

cards.example_en: Additional financial support could soften the impact of rising energy prices on poorer households.
cards.example_zh: 额外的经济援助可以减轻能源价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: After weeks of practice, I finally made a breakthrough.
cards.example_zh: 练习了几周后，我终于取得了突破。
cards.explain_zh: 名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。

cards.example_en: That snowy train journey was a truly memorable experience.
cards.example_zh: 那次雪中火车之旅真是一次难忘的经历。
cards.explain_zh: memorable形容事物难忘，不表示某人记忆力好。

cards.example_en: That snowy train journey was a truly memorable experience.
cards.example_zh: 那次雪中火车之旅真是一次难忘的经历。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I removed two books to lighten my backpack.
cards.example_zh: 我拿出了两本书，让背包轻一些。
cards.explain_zh: lighten可指减负或变亮；lighten up常指放轻松。

cards.example_en: Advertisements can mislead consumers into believing that expensive products always offer better quality than cheaper alternatives.
cards.example_zh: 广告可能误导消费者，使他们相信昂贵产品的质量总比便宜的替代品更好。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为misled；常接into doing。

cards.example_en: Advertisements can mislead consumers into believing that expensive products always offer better quality than cheaper alternatives.
cards.example_zh: 广告可能误导消费者，使他们相信昂贵产品的质量总比便宜的替代品更好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The engine made an alarming noise as we climbed.
cards.example_zh: 我们上坡时，发动机发出了令人不安的声音。
cards.explain_zh: alarming形容事物令人担忧；alarmed形容人感到惊恐。

cards.example_en: We drove southward until we reached the coast.
cards.example_zh: 我们一直向南开车，直到抵达海岸。
cards.explain_zh: southward兼作形容词和副词；southwards仅作副词。

cards.example_en: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一座石拱门下避雨。
cards.explain_zh: 作动词表示弯成拱形，如arch your back。

cards.example_en: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一座石拱门下避雨。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The hotel charges triple the price during holidays.
cards.example_zh: 这家酒店在假日期间收取平时三倍的价格。
cards.explain_zh: triple表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍。

cards.example_en: The ostrich ran quickly across the dusty grassland.
cards.example_zh: 那只鸵鸟飞快地跑过尘土飞扬的草原。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为ostriches；“埋头沙中逃避”并非真实习性。

cards.example_en: Good nutrition helps children grow and stay active.
cards.example_zh: 良好的营养有助于儿童成长并保持活力。
cards.explain_zh: nutrition不可数；nutrient指具体的营养物质。

cards.example_en: Good nutrition helps children grow and stay active.
cards.example_zh: 良好的营养有助于儿童成长并保持活力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
cards.example_zh: 海豚虽然生活在水下，却是哺乳动物。
cards.explain_zh: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

cards.example_en: Walking quietly in the forest gives me spiritual comfort.
cards.example_zh: 在森林里静静散步能给我心灵上的慰藉。
cards.explain_zh: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。

cards.example_en: Public spaces can support spiritual well-being by offering residents peaceful places for reflection and connection with nature.
cards.example_zh: 公共空间可以为居民提供安静思考和亲近自然的场所，从而促进精神健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Possessive behaviour in friendships can limit personal freedom and make it difficult to maintain healthy relationships.
word.example_zh: 友谊中的占有行为会限制个人自由，使健康关系难以维持。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
